one_line: Open finance and bank data aggregation API providing account, transaction, balance, identity, asset, income, and payment data from financial institutions.
auth_notes: client_id + secret pair issued via the Plaid Dashboard after signup; sent in request body or PLAID-CLIENT-ID / PLAID-SECRET headers. Sandbox environment usable immediately; production access must be requested via the Dashboard.
self_serve_notes: Free sandbox signup with test keys; production API access is gated behind a Dashboard request and an underwriting/approval process, then paid.

api_surface.breadth_estimate: Roughly 150+ endpoints across Auth, Transactions, Balance, Identity, Assets, Income, Investments, Liabilities, Transfer, Link tokens, and webhook APIs.
api_surface.webhook_note: Webhook support for item, transactions, income, asset report, and transfer events; configured per item via Dashboard or API.

existing_mcp.note: Plaid publishes an official Plaid MCP server (referenced in the fetched docs text); community servers also exist.

evidence.note: Fetched text of Plaid API overview confirms client_id/secret auth, sandbox vs production access request, and official MCP server.

agent_notes: Production is gated (request via Dashboard), but sandbox is instantly buildable — verdict buildable_today with that caveat.
